statements: Create clamp.mjs at the workspace root: an ES module with one named function export, clamp(value, low, high). Use Node.js built-ins only and no dependencies. Tests, if you write any, go under test/.
value, low and high must each be a finite number, otherwise the function throws a TypeError whose code property is 'E_TYPE'.

low must not be greater than high, otherwise the function throws a RangeError whose code property is 'E_BOUNDS'. The type check comes first: when an argument is not a finite number the code is 'E_TYPE' even if low is greater than high.
The result is low when value is less than low, high when value is greater than high, and value otherwise. low and high themselves are allowed values.
A result that equals zero is returned as +0, never as -0.
The function is pure: no I/O, no shared state, and the arguments are not mutated.
brief: Implement clamp.mjs exactly as the numbered statements specify, then stop. Do not change any other file except tests under test/.
